bottleneck.attribution_boundary: The load generator and API share one physical host, so client HTTP scheduling and host contention cannot be isolated as a remote-generator network result.
bottleneck.method: first frozen guardrail crossing, attributed with client-versus-server latency, queue-wait, prediction, API/load-generator CPU, error, W3C span, and topology telemetry
